title: Expansion of the diagonal inner product
statement: Let $f,g$ be real-valued functions on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, and let $k$ be a nonnegative integer. The diagonal Gowers inner product of $f+g$ equals the sum, over every subset $A$ of the $k$-dimensional Boolean cube, of the Gowers inner product of the family that uses $f$ at cube indices in $A$ and $g$ at all other indices.
